replay_method: Re-derive both implications independently from E6's exact 3-CNF embedding and standard NP/self-reduction facts, without assuming the E7 result.

carrier_to_P_equals_NP: E6 maps arbitrary 3-CNF Phi in polynomial time to an authoritative connected source state P(Phi).
The E7 carrier contract includes polynomial base-feasibility decision on every such state.
Therefore 3-SAT would be in P, implying P=NP.
P_equals_NP_to_carrier: Assume P=NP, hence SAT/3-SAT decision is polynomial.
The signed-Huang state has polynomial-size factor incidence and constant-size local factor tables.
Base/R1/R2 restrictions are representable by polynomial-size CNF/factor updates.
SAT self-reduction reconstructs equality bits with polynomially many decision calls.
Boundary pair states and local C7 witnesses reconstruct the graph coloring in polynomial time.
Successful updates preserve polynomial representation size under sealed deterministic canonical bookkeeping.
scope: The equivalence is only for the declared unrestricted E6 signed-Huang carrier contract.
No claim is made that every P7-free source state is reduced to E6.
